description: The record templates of a project or one table — the layouts ONE record is shown or printed with: each with its name, whether it is a record's page or a tile, and where it is in use now. Call it before update_record_template / delete_record_template to find the template_id, and to answer «which layouts does this table have?».

entity_id.description: Optional: one table. Without it, every table that has a template.

name: list_record_templates
